User message with mixed text and image_url content parts to verify multimodal serialization

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":100,\"messages\":[{\"content\":[{\"text\":\"What is in this image?\",\"type\":\"text\"},{\"image_url\":{\"detail\":\"low\",\"url\":\"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/47/PNG_transparency_demonstration_1.png/280px-PNG_transparency_demonstration_1.png\"},\"type\":\"image_url\"}],\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4o\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)

debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
